The '''Surronian cruiser''' was an ancient<ref name="Fact File" /> and very rare design<ref name="Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> of saucer craft.<ref name="Fact File" /> The [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]] was a knockoff<ref name="Incredible Vehicles" /> of the legendary [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]].<ref name="Fact File" />
